title: Someone Like You

cues.en: I heard that you're settled down
cues.zh: 我聽說你已經定下來了
cues.text: I heard that you're settled down

cues.en: That you found a girl and you're married now
cues.zh: 你找到了一個女孩，你現在結婚了
cues.text: That you found a girl and you're married now

cues.en: I heard that your dreams came true
cues.zh: 我聽說你的夢想成真了
cues.text: I heard that your dreams came true

cues.en: Guess she gave you things I didn't give to you
cues.zh: 我猜她給了你我沒有給你的東西
cues.text: Guess she gave you things I didn't give to you

cues.en: Old friend, why are you so shy?
cues.zh: 老朋友，你為什麼那麼害羞？
cues.text: Old friend, why are you so shy?

cues.en: Ain't like you to hold back or hide from the light
cues.zh: 不像你忍住或躲避光線
cues.text: Ain't like you to hold back or hide from the light

cues.en: I hate to turn up out of the blue, uninvited
cues.zh: 我討厭不請自來突然出現
cues.text: I hate to turn up out of the blue, uninvited

cues.en: But I couldn't stay away, I couldn't fight it
cues.zh: 但我無法離開，我無法抗拒
cues.text: But I couldn't stay away, I couldn't fight it

cues.en: I had hoped you'd see my face
cues.zh: 我本來希望你能看到我的臉
cues.text: I had hoped you'd see my face

cues.en: And that you'd be reminded that for me, it isn't over
cues.zh: 我會提醒你，對我來說，這還沒有結束
cues.text: And that you'd be reminded that for me, it isn't over

cues.en: Never mind, I'll find someone like you
cues.zh: 沒關係，我會找到像你這樣的人
cues.text: Never mind, I'll find someone like you

cues.en: I wish nothing but the best for you, too
cues.zh: 我也只希望你過得好
cues.text: I wish nothing but the best for you, too

cues.en: Don't forget me, I beg
cues.zh: 別忘了我，我求求你
cues.text: Don't forget me, I beg

cues.en: I'll remember, you said
cues.zh: 我會記得，你說
cues.text: I'll remember, you said

cues.en: Sometimes it lasts in love, but sometimes it hurts instead
cues.zh: 有時愛情能廝守到老，有時卻只留下傷害
cues.text: Sometimes it lasts in love, but sometimes it hurts instead

cues.en: Sometimes it lasts in love, but sometimes it hurts instead
cues.zh: 有時愛情能廝守到老，有時卻只留下傷害
cues.text: Sometimes it lasts in love, but sometimes it hurts instead

cues.en: You know how the time flies
cues.zh: 你知道時光飛逝
cues.text: You know how the time flies

cues.en: Only yesterday was the time of our lives
cues.zh: 昨天才是我們生命中的時刻
cues.text: Only yesterday was the time of our lives

cues.en: We were born and raised in a summer haze
cues.zh: 我們在夏天的陰霾中出生長大
cues.text: We were born and raised in a summer haze

cues.en: Bound by the surprise of our glory days
cues.zh: 被我們光榮歲月的驚喜所繫
cues.text: Bound by the surprise of our glory days

cues.en: Nothing compares, no worries or cares
cues.zh: 無可比擬，無需擔心或擔心

cues.en: Regrets and mistakes, they're memories made
